authorization.safe_harbor: We will not pursue legal action against researchers who act in good faith and follow these rules.
authorization.disclosure: Please keep reports private until we confirm the issue is fixed.

testing_rules.automated_scanning: Automated tools are allowed, but you must send no more than 60 requests per minute.
testing_rules.rate_limits: No more than 60 requests per minute.
testing_rules.dos: Denial of service, social engineering and physical attacks are out of scope.
testing_rules.credentials: Use only test accounts that you created yourself.
testing_rules.third_party: payments.example-shop.test is handled by the payment provider; do not test it.
testing_rules.support_or_live_chat: Do not use live chat or support to discuss findings.
testing_rules.social_engineering: Social engineering is out of scope.
testing_rules.data_handling: Do not access data that belongs to other users.
